title: Energy Grid Operator Chatbot POC — Engagement Plan & Pricing Sketch
content:
Purpose and high-level ask:

Customer: Regional GridCo (transmission operator for NE region).
Ask: 6-week POC to validate a supervised LLM-based operator assistant that:
  - Answers operator SOP questions (islanding, emergency voltage support)
  - Summarizes multi-source incident timelines (SCADA + outage logs + shift notes)
  - Provides reranking/prioritization of alerts for triage during high-load events

Primary success criteria (how GridCo will judge POC):
  - Precision: >= 85% of answers verified by SME as correct or acceptable on 40-seat test set
  - Latency: 95th percentile end-to-end (request->final answer) < 700ms for text queries in our lab environment with 4k context
  - Throughput: sustain 20 concurrent interactive sessions with average 2 requests/sec/session without degradation
  - Integration: successful demo pulling time-series snippets from SCADA mock and ingesting outage CSVs

Scope (what we will deliver in 6 weeks):
  Phase 0 (week -1 to 0): kickoff, security review, target persona mapping, dataset access checklist.
  Phase 1 (weeks 1-2): prompt engineering + retrieval prototype using Redwood hosted API + simple document store (S3 + vector index). Deliverable: demo-able retrieval-augmented chat flow, smoke tests.
  Phase 2 (weeks 3-4): fine-tune hybrid approach: Redwood-hosted model with on-the-fly reranking, KV caching for session state, latency tuning. Deliverable: internal performance report + curated prompt set.
  Phase 3 (weeks 5-6): integration and operator workshop, edge cases, evaluation against SME-annotated test set, handoff notes. Deliverable: POC report, recommendations for Dedicated deployment and draft SOW for production rollout.

Out-of-scope for the POC (explicit):
  - Full production data ingestion/ETL pipelines from live SCADA (we will use sanitized extracts)
content_continued:
- Long-term retention, HA, and SLA commitments (post-POC proposal only)
  - Custom model training from scratch (we will evaluate fine-tune/adapter options only)

Customer responsibilities (what GridCo must provide rapidly):
  - Access to sanitized sample incident logs (CSV) and a small SCADA timeseries export (1 week worth)
  - Two named SMEs for weekly check-ins and a final evaluation session
  - Approval for test user accounts and VPN access for demo environment if required

Redwood responsibilities (what we commit):
  - Provide Redwood-hosted inference endpoint config, sample retrieval index, evaluation harness, and 2 onsite/remote engineer days during the integration workshop
  - Deliver final POC report with quantitative evaluation, recommended production topology (Dedicated vs Private), and cost model for 12-month run rates

High-level technical approach notes (working):
  - Model choice: start with an open 70B-parameter model quantized to 4-bit hosted variant; if latency unacceptable, fallback to smaller 13B quantized variant.
  - Retrieval: vector embeddings using Redwood embeddings endpoint, FAISS index on S3-backed store for fast cold starts.
  - Caching: session-level KV cache for operator context + prefix caching for repeated SOP queries.
  - Routing: use smart-routing rule to prefer lower-latency variant for interactive sessions, fallback to cheaper variant for async batch summarization.

Draft pricing sketch (POC engagement only) — ballpark, not final:
  - Fixed services fee (6-week POC): USD 68,000 (engineering time: 4 engineers @ 6 wks fractional + PM + workshop days)
  - Hosted usage estimate: USD 4,500 — includes model usage for 6-week active testing, vector index storage, and small eval runs (assumes ~100k tokens total)
  - Optional on-site workshop travel (2 engineers, 2 days): USD 4,000 (if requested)
  - Contingency (change requests > 10% scope): hourly T&M at 175 USD/hr
  - Estimated total (typical): ~USD 76–80k

Notes on production transition cost drivers (post-POC):
  - Expected major cost levers: chosen model size, request QPS, cache hit rate, KV memory footprint per session, enterprise networking/VPC packaging, and audit log retention.
  - Example rack-level Dedicated estimate: USD 40k–120k monthly depending on committed capacity and redundancy (we will produce a formal Dedicated sizing after POC).

Workshop agenda (half-day operator-focused):
  - 09:00 — intro + project goals and constraints (15m)
  - 09:15 — operator personas and pain points mapping (30m)
  - 09:45 — live demo: retrieval-augmented assistant with sample incidents (20m)
  - 10:10 — hands-on: operators run 6 scripted queries (30m)
  - 10:45 — break (10m)
  - 10:55 — evaluation rubric and SME scoring (25m)
  - 11:20 — integration checklist and next-step discussion (25m)

Open questions / risks (for customer and Redwood to resolve early):
  - Data sensitivity: what exact fields must be redacted from outage logs? (impact: dataset prep time)
  - Live integration: will GridCo accept a VPN-tunneled demo or require on-prem appliance? (impact: deployment mode recommendation)
  - SME availability: we need 2 SMEs for weekly reviews and final scoring — confirmation needed by kickoff.
  - Regulatory/audit features: are immutable audit logs required for POC evaluation? (if yes, scope increases)

Evaluation plan and sample test cases (summary):
  - Build a 40-query benchmark split across SOP lookup (18 queries), incident summary (12 queries), and triage-priority ranking (10 queries). Each query will be rated by SMEs on accuracy (correct/partial/incorrect) and helpfulness (1-5).
  - Target: 85% correct/acceptable across the benchmark, average helpfulness >= 4.0

Deliverables list (end of POC):
  - Demo-ready assistant with retrieval index and configuration snapshot
  - POC technical report (performance, costs, evaluation, limitations)
  - Production rollout recommendation (Dedicated vs Private) and draft SOW for production phase
  - Handoff notes, runbook snippets, operator prompts, and prompt-set for regression tests

Next steps (immediate):
  1) Confirm scope and sign POC engagement (PO acceptance email).
  2) Customer to share sample sanitized datasets by Jan 17.
  3) Kickoff scheduled for Jan 20 (30m) — agenda: security review, IAM needs, SME introductions.

Quick internal TODOs (for Redwood SE team):
  - [ ] Prep retrieval demo dataset (Priya)
  - [ ] Baseline latency runs with 70B quantized hosted variant (Samir)
  - [ ] Draft production sizing worksheet template for post-POC (Diego)
  - [ ] Create Linear ticket for redaction checklist (owner: Avery)

Slack/refs and shorthand used in doc:
  - Slack thread: #se-gridco-poc (internal channel)
  - Linear epics: SE-GRIDCO-POC, link after kickoff

Notes to self (informal):
  - Consider precomputing SOP chunks + anchors to improve recall on short queries.
  - If latency target missed, prioritize: quantized smaller model -> reduce context window -> increase cache TTL for SOP queries.
  - Need to confirm if GridCo prefers encryption-in-transit only or also encryption-at-rest with customer-managed keys (affects Private deployment estimate).

End of document.
